identity.name: KRSNAA DIAGNOSTICS LTD
identity.industry: Healthcare / Integrated Diagnostics & Public-Private Radiology Infrastructure

summary.oneLiner: Krsnaa delivered 11% YoY revenue growth and 29% EBITDA margin despite PPP contract transitions, driven by retail scaling and operational efficiencies; the imminent Rajasthan PPP rollout by Dec 2025 is the key catalyst for FY27 revenue acceleration and margin uplift.

one-line thesis: Krsnaa delivered 11% YoY revenue growth and 29% EBITDA margin despite PPP contract transitions, driven by retail scaling and operational efficiencies; the imminent Rajasthan PPP rollout by Dec 2025 is the key catalyst for FY27 revenue acceleration and margin uplift.
financial scorecard: revenue: +11% YoY; EBITDA: +18% YoY, margin expanded 221 bps to 29%; PAT: +22% YoY, 12% margin; order book: Rajasthan PPP (10 labs by Nov, 25 labs + 500 centers by Dec, 152 labs + 1,100 centers by end-Q4); net debt: increased due to working capital timing (receivables at 150 days, targeted to 100 days by FY26 end); one-off: receivables spike due to SNA-SPARSH system transition in govt payments
guidance: revenue growth: higher teens YoY in FY27; margin: sustained 29%+ EBITDA margin; order inflow: pipeline active but undisclosed; capex/commissioning: Rajasthan PPP full rollout by end-Q4FY26, no new equity raise planned
order book & pipeline: Rajasthan PPP: 10 labs operational by Nov 2025; 25 labs + 500 collection centers by Dec 2025; 152 labs + 1,100 collection centers by end-Q4FY26
segment / subsidiary detail: Radiology: 200+ CT/MRI centers (largest fleet in Asia); Pathology: 57 NABL labs; Retail: 60% QoQ growth, 8% of H1 revenue, targeting 15-20% in FY27; PPP: 18 states covered, 36 NABH radiology centers, India’s first CAP pathology lab in govt facility
growth verticals / optionality: Retail to contribute 40-50% of revenue in 5 years; expansion into wellness/preventive diagnostics; AI-driven reporting and home collection scaling; potential for national PPP tender wins
margins & cost dynamics: EBITDA margin expanded to 29% via labor productivity, radiology utilization optimization, supply chain efficiency, and automation; retail still loss-making but breakeven expected at ~Rs.100cr revenue
capex / expansion: Rajasthan PPP CAPEX underway; no new equity raise planned; capital efficiency maintained via leasing and optimized deployment
capital allocation: Prioritizing internal accruals and debt for Rajasthan rollout; no dividend or buyback mentioned; focus on ROCE improvement toward 15%+
risks & watch-items: Govt payment delays (SNA-SPARSH system issues); receivables cycle extension (150 days); operational disruption from natural disasters (e.g., Punjab/Himachal floods); retail breakeven delayed beyond initial expectations
management quality / tone: Confident, mission-driven, emphasizing scale, quality, and social impact; optimistic on retail and Rajasthan rollout; transparent on working capital issues but dismissive of long-term risk
non-obvious takeaways: Krsnaa’s 36 NABH + 57 NABL + CAP + ACR accreditations create an unmatched quality moat in public diagnostics; retail growth is being funded by PPP cash flows, not equity; senior citizen access is already embedded via PPP, not a separate initiative

themes.title: Hospitals, diagnostics & domestic healthcare
themes.need: Under-bedded India plus insurance penetration and preventive-care adoption drive a domestic healthcare capex + volume cycle distinct from export pharma. MAXHEALTH adding ~2,500+ beds (Gurgaon 500-bed by FY27); APOLLOHOSP/MEDANTA/KIMS/NH/ASTERDM/MAXHEALTH on hospitals; LALPATHLAB/METROPOLIS/THYROCARE/VIJAYA on diagnostics (LALPATHLAB guides 13-15% FY27); MEDPLUS/ENTERO on pharmacy/distribution; POLYMED on devices. The same India-only demand engine now also carries India-facing branded pharma, which is driven by domestic volume and price rather than the export book: GLAXO delivered its first INR 1,000cr quarter with 8.1% revenue growth, Shingrix at a ~INR 75cr annual run-rate (CY25, +80% YoY) and Jemperli's first-line approval expanding eligible patients from 800 to 6,000; ERIS (dermatology 15% of revenue after INR 1,265cr of domestic brand acquisitions), SANOFI (India-for-India, NLEM price cuts) and THEMISMED (hospital segment +20% YoY) sit on the same axis.
themes.driver: New-bed commissioning + occupancy ramp; Tier 3/4 diagnostics penetration; CGHS rate revision; preventive-test volumes; domestic branded-formulation volume growth and NLEM/price actions.
